 Basketball Philadelphia 76ers Tyrese Maxey VJ Edgecombe Tyrese Maxey had hilarious message for 76ers teammate after missed layup
 November 6, 2026 by Dan Benton • Comments Facebook Tweet LinkedIn Reddit Threads WhatsApp Email May 5, 2023; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA; Philadelphia 76ers guard Tyrese Maxey (0) against the Boston Celtics during game three of the 2023 NBA playoffs at Wells Fargo Center. Mandatory Credit: Eric Hartline-USA TODAY Sports 
 Add as a preferred source on Google 
 Tyrese Maxey delivered a memorable reaction after Philadelphia 76ers teammate VJ Edgecombe missed a late-third-quarter layup during Wednesday’s 112-106 road victory over the Detroit Pistons .
 With the Sixers leading 91-75 as the third-quarter buzzer approached, Edgecombe pushed the ball on a fast break but could not convert against Cade Cunningham . Maxey immediately offered a four-word response that mixed blunt assessment with quick encouragement.
 Tyrese Maxey told VJ Edgecombe he was ASS after missing a layup at the buzzer 😭😭
Sixers team chemistry going crazy pic.twitter.com/nbRiZvOIiy 
— thirty33 (@thirtyy33) November 5, 2026 
 “You ass! It’s OK,” he cracked.
 The exchange highlighted the easygoing chemistry between the All-Star guard and his second-year backcourt partner.
 Edgecombe, selected third overall in the 2025 draft after starring at Baylor, finished with 11 points, six rebounds and three assists across 35 minutes. Maxey, navigating a demanding stretch that marked the team’s fourth game in six nights, managed 19 points on 5-of-16 shooting while recording seven assists and just one turnover.
 Philadelphia improved to 8-1 behind 30 points from Jaylen Brown and a 26-point, 15-rebound effort from Joel Embiid .
 The clip spread rapidly on social media, with multiple accounts sharing the moment and ESPN’s NBA account posting it under a caption that noted Maxey’s direct style with the younger player. By the following afternoon, the ESPN post had drawn hundreds of thousands of views.
 Coach Nick Nurse praised Maxey’s composure despite the defensive focus he faces, and Maxey dismissed any mention of fatigue as simply part of NBA life.
 The viral sequence displayed the candid yet supportive dynamic Maxey has established with Edgecombe as the Sixers continue building around their young core during a strong early-season run.
